items.title: Podcast: Securing AI Agents: Identity, Authorization, and the DPACT Framework
items.blurb: In this episode, Sahil Agarwal talks about the critical challenges of identity, authorisation, and security in the age of AI agents.

items.title: Kubernetes 1.37 Released: Stable Metrics API and Rootless Kubelet in Beta
items.blurb: The Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) announced the release of Kubernetes 1.37, named "Garhwal", emphasizing its focus on stability, security, and AI/ML workload optimization. By Mostafa Radwan
